items.title: Ann Rabson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 21, 2007
items.q: Big Joe Turner was one. And he did some wonderful stuff. I said the stuff he did with Pete Johnson just knocked me out.

ctx.x: To you what — is there a line between something that pushes something over from blues into rock & roll?

Naaah. That’s blues. I mean come on. But that is rock & roll. And that’s what was on the juke box when I was coming up. I mean we had some stuff which I would definitely consider blues. Big Joe Turner was one. And he did some wonderful stuff. I said the stuff he did with Pete Johnson just knocked me out. But anyway, Big Joe.
